capabilities: draw and edit content on a tldraw whiteboard inside Obsidian
store each drawing as a regular Markdown file
switch between tldraw view and Markdown view
toggle view modes via command palette, hotkeys, status bar, and menus
download tldraw fonts, icons, and translations for local use
disambiguation: Not the standalone tldraw app; it embeds tldraw into Obsidian and stores each drawing as a Markdown file in the vault.
extras: Makes network requests by default: the tldraw editor loads assets from the tldraw CDN, and the tldraw library fetches a small license-tracking image; assets can be downloaded locally in settings to avoid CDN use.
problem: Obsidian lacks a built-in freehand drawing canvas backed by editable Markdown files, so sketches can't live in the vault as plain data.

relations.evidence: This Obsidian plugin allows users to use tldraw, which is a tiny little drawing app, inside of Obsidian.
shout out to the Excalidraw plugin for inspiration on how I should structure this tldraw plugin

summary: Embeds the tldraw whiteboard in Obsidian, letting users draw and edit sketches that are saved as plain Markdown files.
